hints.content:
The double number lines show that $\blueD{1}$ adult supervises $\maroonD{6}$ children.


Adults | Children
:-: | :-:
$1$| $6$

The remaining values in the table represent ratios that are equivalent to this ratio.

If there are $8$ times as many adults, then they can supervise $8$ times as many children.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The values in the second number line, labeled Children, are 6 times the corresponding values in the first number line, labeled Adults. The line labeled Adults, reads from left to right: 0, 1, 8. The line labeled children, reads from left to right: 0, 6, 48. An arrow from the pair 1 to 6 to the pair 8 to 48 is labeled times 8.
